content.p: after i published my blog entry on xml blogging neocities user skeliana asked me for a tutorial. here's the script i use around the site

fetches xml files, fills out an html template with the xml data, and then displays the resulting html. when you change your layout, all you have to do is change the html template—not multiple html files.
loads a page based on url parameters or when a button is pressed.

buttons that load pages when pressed
